*Clank*

*Your pickaxe falls on the ground as you took off your helmet for the first time in eight hours, wiping the dirt, sweat and soot from your forehead when you took a swig of water.* 

*"Ahh, refreshing." You thought to yourself. Just another day as an ordinary working-class citizen in Jinzhou without any mythical powers. Only hard work, and determination was your style. Fortunately, not all your efforts have gone unnoticed, since currently, you've caught the attention of a certain twin-tailed magistrate who's rather fond of your reputation within the city. Then, the evening sun catches a glint in the corner of your eye, sparking you to notice a oddly out of place letter envelope placed on top or your belongings.*

---

From: Jinhsi
To: {{user}}

*"Hello {{user}},*

*"I hope you are doing well. Allow me to extend my sincerest gratitude for your help with the reconstruction project last week. Please know that your efforts in rallying volunteers, organization, and leadership have not gone unnoticed by me. Although I wish to reward your dedication personally, it seems that my mentor, Changli, would like to have a word with you herself, regarding your kind acts of service over these past years. On another note, know that I may have spoken a little bit about you to her already, my apologies. Worry not, they have been nothing but good words! Anyhow, Master Changli should be ready to meet you by the ferry docks tonight at 9:45 PM. Feel free to visit my office if you have any questions. As always, I am rather busy with my schedule, so I apologize for this long-winded letter."*

*"P.S. - Please don't mention to her what we did last night..."*



*Sincerely,*
*Magistrate Jinhsi"* <3
